query:
DEFINE
    VAR _entity   = TREATAS ( { "GROUP" }, param_entity_view[entity_view_code] )
    VAR _fy       = TREATAS ( { 2025 }, param_fiscal_year[fiscal_year] )
    VAR _month    = TREATAS ( { 12 }, param_period[month_number] )
    VAR _tv       = TREATAS ( { "FY" }, param_time_view[time_view_code] )
    VAR _base     = TREATAS ( { "A" }, param_base_version[choice_code] )
    VAR _cmp_a    = TREATAS ( { "B" }, param_compare_a[choice_code] )
    VAR _cmp_b    = TREATAS ( { "PY" }, param_compare_b[choice_code] )
    VAR _ccy      = TREATAS ( { "USD" }, param_reporting_currency[currency_code] )
    VAR _fx       = TREATAS ( { "CC" }, param_fx_basis[fx_basis_code] )
    VAR _units    = TREATAS ( { "M" }, param_units[units_code] )
    VAR _entity_p = TREATAS ( { "P" }, param_entity_view[entity_view_code] )
    VAR _entity_s = TREATAS ( { "S" }, param_entity_view[entity_view_code] )
    VAR _cells_p =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
                dim_region[region_code]
                ,dim_region[region_name]
                ,dim_line[line_code]
                ,dim_line[line_name]
                ,dim_line[sort_order]
                ,TREATAS ( { "P" }, dim_line[entity_code] )
                ,TREATAS ( { FALSE () }, dim_line[is_unassigned] )
                ,_entity_p, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units
                ,"@nr", CONVERT ( [Prof Net Revenue], DOUBLE )
                ,"@gm", CONVERT ( [KPI Gross Margin %], DOUBLE )
            )
            ,"@region", dim_region[region_code]
            ,"@region_name", dim_region[region_name]
            ,"@line", dim_line[line_code]
            ,"@line_name", dim_line[line_name]
            ,"@line_sort", dim_line[sort_order]
            ,"@nr", [@nr]
            ,"@gm", [@gm]
        )
    VAR _lines_p =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
                dim_line[line_code]
                ,dim_line[line_name]
                ,dim_line[sort_order]
                ,TREATAS ( { "P" }, dim_line[entity_code] )
                ,TREATAS ( { FALSE () }, dim_line[is_unassigned] )
                ,_entity_p, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units
                ,"@nr", CONVERT ( [Prof Net Revenue], DOUBLE )
                ,"@gm", CONVERT ( [KPI Gross Margin %], DOUBLE )
            )
            ,"@region", ""
            ,"@region_name", ""
            ,"@line", dim_line[line_code]
            ,"@line_name", dim_line[line_name]
            ,"@line_sort", dim_line[sort_order]
            ,"@nr", [@nr]
            ,"@gm", [@gm]
        )
    VAR _cells_s =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
                dim_region[region_code]
                ,dim_region[region_name]
                ,dim_line[line_code]
                ,dim_line[line_name]
                ,dim_line[sort_order]
                ,TREATAS ( { "S" }, dim_line[entity_code] )
                ,TREATAS ( { FALSE () }, dim_line[is_unassigned] )
                ,_entity_s, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units
                ,"@nr", CONVERT ( [Prof Net Revenue], DOUBLE )
                ,"@gm", CONVERT ( [KPI Gross Margin %], DOUBLE )
            )
            ,"@region", dim_region[region_code]
            ,"@region_name", dim_region[region_name]
            ,"@line", dim_line[line_code]
            ,"@line_name", dim_line[line_name]
            ,"@line_sort", dim_line[sort_order]
            ,"@nr", [@nr]
            ,"@gm", [@gm]
        )
    VAR _lines_s =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
                dim_line[line_code]
                ,dim_line[line_name]
                ,dim_line[sort_order]
                ,TREATAS ( { "S" }, dim_line[entity_code] )
                ,TREATAS ( { FALSE () }, dim_line[is_unassigned] )
                ,_entity_s, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units
                ,"@nr", CONVERT ( [Prof Net Revenue], DOUBLE )
                ,"@gm", CONVERT ( [KPI Gross Margin %], DOUBLE )
            )
            ,"@region", ""
            ,"@region_name", ""
            ,"@line", dim_line[line_code]
            ,"@line_name", dim_line[line_name]
            ,"@line_sort", dim_line[sort_order]
            ,"@nr", [@nr]
            ,"@gm", [@gm]
        )
    VAR _regions =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
                dim_region[region_code]
                ,dim_region[region_name]
                ,_entity, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units
                ,"@nr", CONVERT ( [Prof Net Revenue], DOUBLE )
                ,"@gm", CONVERT ( [KPI Gross Margin %], DOUBLE )
            )
            ,"@region", dim_region[region_code]
            ,"@region_name", dim_region[region_name]
            ,"@line", ""
            ,"@line_name", ""
            ,"@line_sort", 0
            ,"@nr", [@nr]
            ,"@gm", [@gm]
        )
    VAR _company =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            CALCULATETABLE (
                ROW ( "@nr", CONVERT ( [Prof Net Revenue], DOUBLE ), "@gm", CONVERT ( [KPI Gross Margin %], DOUBLE ) )
                ,_entity, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units
            )
            ,"@region", ""
            ,"@region_name", ""
            ,"@line", ""
            ,"@line_name", ""
            ,"@line_sort", 0
            ,"@nr", [@nr]
            ,"@gm", [@gm]
        )
EVALUATE
UNION ( _cells_p, _lines_p, _cells_s, _lines_s, _regions, _company )
ORDER BY [@region], [@line_sort]
